screening_decisions.reason: Animal study using mice, not a human randomized controlled trial. The selection criteria require human RCTs comparing embryo transfer media.
Animal study using bovine embryos, not a human randomized controlled trial.
Matched controlled study, not a truly randomized controlled trial. The study design involved matching women rather than randomization.
Randomized clinical trial comparing HA-enriched embryo transfer medium (study group) vs routine medium without HA (control group) in human patients. Meets all selection criteria.
Prospective randomized controlled trial comparing hyaluronan-enriched transfer medium (HETM) vs conventional embryo transfer medium in human patients. Meets all selection criteria.
Study focuses on freezing protocol parameters (temperature and cooling rate), not on comparing embryo transfer media with vs without adherence compounds.
Animal study using mice, basic science research on hyaluronate synthesis. Not a human randomized controlled trial.

Basic science study examining CD44 expression, not a randomized controlled trial comparing embryo transfer media.
Case-control study, not a truly randomized controlled trial. The study design involved comparing consecutive patients rather than randomization.

Basic science study on protein binding, not a clinical trial comparing embryo transfer media.
Cochrane review article, not a primary randomized controlled trial.

Observational study, not a randomized controlled trial. The abstract states it was an 'observational study' comparing two commercially available transfer media.

Prospective case-control study, not a randomized controlled trial. The study design involved comparing groups without randomization.

Animal study using mouse embryos, not a human randomized controlled trial.

Randomized trial comparing single vs double blastocyst transfer. Does not compare embryo transfer media with vs without adherence compounds.
